status: No verified local sportfishing-charter tracks in 11 sampled daily NOAA files

archive.provider: NOAA Office for Coastal Management / MarineCadastre; U.S. Coast Guard AIS
archive.availability_note: Latest date in this daily index at retrieval, not a claim about every NOAA product. File modification timestamps are not vessel broadcast dates.

geographic_screen.description: Regional inventory covering Avila–Cambria; public habitat map ends at Point Estero. No speed, depth, or vessel-name prefilter was used while retaining regional broadcasts.

sample_design: Eleven selected spring/summer dates. June 24–30 is a continuous seven-UTC-day block; the four other dates are isolated. This is not a full-season or full-fleet census. Bounding-box retention does not establish complete trip tracks or reception. UTC boundaries can split Pacific-local trips.

fleet_name_screen.normalization: Uppercase; remove all characters except A–Z and 0–9; exact comparison to researched names. Name matches are leads requiring independent identity confirmation, not vessel identifications.

supplemental_research.product: NOAA PMEL AIS annual inventory samples, 2018–2024
supplemental_research.result: Sparse regional samples inspected for vessel identity leads; at most one retained position per vessel per UTC day. Not suitable for reconstructing fishing stops, drift lines, or trip coverage.
Name inventories inspected; geographic track extraction did not complete. No local track analysis is claimed from this product.

supplemental_research.product: Global Fishing Watch v3 apparent commercial fishing effort, July and September 2024
supplemental_research.result: Public no-account Zenodo archive obtained via verified ranges. Regional 0.01-degree cells aggregated separately from charter evidence; no recreational operator, exact catch, species or depth qualification inferred. See commercial AIS metadata for completed coverage and filtering.

supplemental_research.product: NOAA 2026-06-24 through 2026-06-26 additional raw daily samples
supplemental_research.result: Three complete national files processed; 28,822,625 national rows and 8,538 regional broadcasts added. Zero researched local sportfishing-charter name matches. Repeated low-speed commercial name leads remain research context, not verified fishing stops.

requirements: Independently verify the local sportfishing vessel identity, including MMSI and operator context.
Analyze full time-ordered trips and exclude harbor waiting, transit, and non-fishing operations.
Repeated low-speed bouts must overlap surveyed habitat within current legal and depth limits.
Record actual coverage, gaps, dates, and identity confidence alongside any inferred activity.
proposed_visit_evidence_gate.interpretation: A research heuristic for repeated charter visits, not validated proof of fishing or catch success. No location presently passes the identity gate.

limitations: Not all fishing boats carry or transmit AIS.
Reception gaps, unknown vessel names and local-trip timing limit detection.
A vessel type of fishing does not establish recreational charter identity.
General traffic density, one daily point, and transit through a reef cannot establish a fishing hotspot.
Exact-name screening can miss changed, shortened, blank, or differently reported identities.
The eight dates do not cover the full season or establish current fishing activity.
AIS evidence is separate from terrain grades; no AIS bonus has been applied to any target.
